content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The pale green and orange background graphic passes directly behind the body copy and the studio photo is awkwardly pushed to the right, leaving an empty white column on the left.",
  "desktopNote": "Clean, confident typography and custom-feeling card shapes give the page a bespoke identity, though the vertical graphic stripe and orange dot sit too close to the hero headline.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 5,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 5,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 5,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Make the mobile hero photo span the full width of the content container instead of indenting it on the left.",
    "Move or fade the decorative background stripe and orange shape on mobile so they do not intersect with the hero text.",
    "Prevent '200 €' from wrapping onto two lines in the mobile pricing card by slightly reducing the price font size on narrow viewports."
  ]
}
